Who We Are

Founded in 2008, Arabian Processing Glass Co. today is one of the GCC region’s leading architectural glass processors equipped with modern manufacturing facilities to deliver complete glass solutions for all commercial and residential building requirements. Employing a team of highly skilled professionals and technicians, APG manufactures and delivers glazing products and services to major aluminum customers, structural glazing installers, real-estate developers and building construction contractors.
